visualCharacteristics: Narrow (~800px) column: centered 'FAQs' heading, 12-item accordion with chevrons and grey dividers, a small white 'Chat with us / Need help?' WhatsApp card, then three left-aligned blue underlined links.
contentPattern:
Interactive expand/collapse Q&A. All answers are in the server HTML and are imported statically into the accordion rows.

Narrow FAQ list, bold questions, thin grey dividers, chevron toggle on the right.
usage: Narrow FAQ list of collapsible question/answer items with chevrons and dividers.
reuseGuidance: One row per question. Cell 1: question. Cell 2: answer (any rich text). Uses native details/summary, so it works without JS styling and is keyboard accessible. Put the FAQs heading and follow-up links as default content around the block.
